editorial_review.summary: Corrected the FIX checksum and its three-digit rendering, documented CSV logical record numbering rather than physical lines, and noted that numeric accumulation can overflow.

edits.old: For this exact prefix, the sum is 2268, so $2268 \\bmod 256 = 220$. The trailer value is consequently `10=220`, followed by the final SOH.
edits.new: For this exact prefix, the sum is 2312, so $2312 \\bmod 256 = 8$. The trailer value is consequently `10=008`, with the checksum rendered as three decimal digits, followed by the final SOH.

edits.old: `ragged_rows` lists one-based file line numbers whose field count differs from the header; those records are skipped when column summaries are calculated.
edits.new: `ragged_rows` lists one-based CSV record numbers (with the header as record 1) whose field count differs from the header; those records are skipped when column summaries are calculated.

edits.old: Large numeric sums can lose floating-point precision.
edits.new: Large numeric sums can lose floating-point precision or overflow, in which case JSON output fails.
